title: fluid-config API file
description: <dynamic_dir>/apis/**/*.json — one file is one REST API at /<version>/<name>: its contract, who may call it, and its records (data). Writes through the API or console rewrite this file atomically.

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for editor validation.

enabled.description: false: the API answers 404 (the file is kept).

id_field.description: Field that identifies a record (in /<version>/<name>/{id}). Numeric ids are generated as max+1 when omitted on create, others as random hex.

methods.description: Allowed methods; others get 405. Default read-only.

header.description: api_key: the header carrying the key.

tokens.description: bearer / api_key. Each is "env:VAR" (read from the environment), "sha256:<hex>" (only the hash is stored) or a literal. Prefix env: and sha256: values with "name=" to name the credential in logs and the history (e.g. "ci-bot=env:CI_TOKEN").

users.description: basic: user -> password (literal, env:VAR or sha256:<hex>).

read_public.description: GET needs no credentials; writes still do.

allowed_ips.description: Who may call this API. Omitted: loopback and private networks only (restricted default), so internet clients get 403. ["*"]: anyone (pair it with auth).

cidrs.description: Same as allowed_ips (kept from the first release); both lists are combined.

rate_limit.description: Token bucket per client IP (429 with Retry-After beyond it).

rate_limit_per_min.description: Older form of rate_limit (burst = the same number).

cache_seconds.description: Cache-Control max-age clients and CDNs may keep answers for. ETag and 304 Not Modified are always on.

cache.description: In-memory response cache on the server: GET responses are kept per query until ttl_seconds pass or the data changes (any write or edit of this file). Purge it from the console.

max_entries.description: Distinct queries kept; least recently used are dropped.

cors_origins.description: Browser origins allowed to call it (https://app.example.com) or "*".

strict_fields.description: Refuse fields not declared in fields.

max_records.description: Refuse creates beyond this many records (0 = no limit).

data.description: The records. Each must carry the id_field and pass the fields' rules.

required.description: Must be present (and not null) on create and replace.

min.description: Minimum value for numbers, minimum length for strings.

max.description: Maximum value for numbers, maximum length for strings.

pattern.description: Regular expression (Go RE2) strings must match.
